OnEngineSecondaryModeStart Fired when an engine enters its secondary operating mode. OnEngineSecondaryModeStop Fired when an engine exits its secondary operating mode. AssemblyCSharp/GlobalAssemblyCSharp.Surf.summary: Class SurfaceLandmark Authoring wrapper that coordinates a smoothing decal, prefab spawner, and discoverable entry at one lat/lon on a celestial body. Inheritance object SurfaceLandmark Namespace: GlobalAssemblyCSharp Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public class SurfaceLandmark : MonoBehaviour Remarks Pure data at runtime. The SDK's editor-side sync helper reads these fields and reconciles the three managed children (PQSDecalInstance, ReduxSurfaceSpawner, ScienceRegionData entry) under the PQS. The wrapper GameObject itself is stripped from outgoing scenes by the build pre-process pass. If the strip is skipped for any reason the wrapper is harmless because it has no runtime behavior. Lat/lon/altitude are the source of truth for placement. The wrapper's Unity transform is a scene-view echo derived from these doubles by the sync helper, not the authoring surface. When false, the decal is purely cosmetic (no terrain modification). Declaration public bool EnableSmoothing Field Value Type Description bool Latitude Latitude in degrees. Ignored when UseRawAddressableKey is on. RandomAnimationTriggerManager Fires a named Animator trigger at a random interval between a configurable minimum and maximum wait time. SetRandomPosition Randomizes the position of its transform on enable, either by applying a random vector offset within a configurable range or by moving to one of a set of target transforms. SimpleFidgetManager Manages randomized fidget animation cycles for a Kerbal character, driving an Animator with configurable idle animation sets and randomized timing intervals. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.CampaignPlayerMP.summary: Enum CampaignPlayerMPActionField Identifies the field of a campaign player's state targeted by a multiplayer action. Namespace: KSP.Game Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public enum CampaignPlayerMPActionField : byte Fields Name Description ActiveCameraGroup The active camera group assigned to the player. ActiveCameraInfo The active camera configuration for the player. ActiveLocalSpaceCB The active local-space celestial body for the player. ActiveVesselGuid The globally unique identifier of the player's active vessel. ActiveVesselName The name of the player's active vessel. AddFavoritedPart An operation that adds a single part to the player's favorites list. AgencyId The identifier of the agency associated with the player. CompletedFTUEs The set of first-time user experience sequences completed by the player. CompletedTutorials The set of tutorials completed by the player. CopyLocationString The location string used when copying the player's current position. FavoritedParts The collection of parts marked as favorites by the player. FlightControlState The current flight control state of the player's vessel. HistoricalGameState The historical game state record for the player. IsFTUEEnabled The flag indicating whether the first-time user experience is enabled for the player. LastOABConfig The most recent Object Assembly Building configuration for the player. LastOABWorkspaceSnapshot The most recent snapshot of the player's Object Assembly Building workspace. Missions The collection of missions associated with the player. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.Flow.html.title: Namespace KSP.Game.Flow | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.Flow.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Game.Flow Classes FlowAction A base class for a named, timed action within a game flow sequence, executed asynchronously with resolve and reject callbacks. FreezeProceduralPartDefinitionDatabaseFlowAction Flow action that freezes and caches the procedural part definition database, preventing new definitions from being added. FreezeResourceDefinitionDatabaseFlowAction Flow action that freezes the resource definition database, preventing new resource definitions from being added. GenericFlowAction A FlowAction implementation that executes a caller-supplied delegate as the action's work. LoadAssetFlowAction<T> A FlowAction that loads a Unity asset of type T from an AssetProvider using a string key. LoadAssetReferenceFlowAction<T> FlowAction that loads an UnityEngine.AddressableAssets.AssetReferenceT<TObject> using an AssetProvider and delivers the result through a callback. LoadAssetReferencesFlowAction<T> FlowAction that loads a list of Addressable asset references of type T via an AssetProvider. LoadAssetsFlowAction<T> FlowAction that loads a batch of assets of type T from an AssetProvider, invoking a per-asset callback and a completion callback on finish. LoadStartingCelestialBodyFlowAction A FlowAction that loads the starting celestial body's space view during game load, waiting for its local-space or scaled-space representation to finish spawning. PopulateProceduralPartDatabaseFlowAction Flow action that loads procedural part assets and populates the procedural part definition database. PopulateResourceDefinitionDatabaseFlowAction FlowAction that loads resource definition assets and populates the game's resource definition database. ReduxFlowAction Wraps an IFlowAction as a KSP FlowAction, delegating name, description, and execution to the underlying Redux action. SaveGameMetadataLoader Manages a collection of SavedGameMetaDataLoaderInstance instances that load metadata from saved game files. SaveGameThumbnailCreator Creates thumbnail image files for save game entries by asynchronously capturing the screen and encoding the result to disk. SavedGameMetaDataLoaderInstance Represents a single asynchronous instance for loading saved-game metadata from disk, invoking a callback when the load completes or fails. SequentialFlow Represents a sequential execution pipeline that runs a list of FlowAction items one at a time, tracking flow state, progress, and errors. Delegates OnLoadCleanup Handler invoked to perform cleanup after a load operation on a SavedGameMetaDataLoaderInstance.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Game Classes ActionGroupActionElement Represents a single action available for action group mapping, wrapping a ModuleActionGroupAction with bindable display and mapping state properties. ActionGroupElement Represents a single action group entry in the game UI, providing data-bound properties and actions for a KSPActionGroup. ActionGroupManager Pop-up UI manager for assigning and managing action groups for vessel parts in flight and Object Assembly Building contexts. AgencyColorPicker Represents a UI color picker for selecting agency base and accent colors in HSV color space. AgencyEntry Represents a single in-game agency, holding its identity, appearance, science-point data, missions, and resource scan history. AgencyFlag Represents an agency flag, including its name, icon sprite, and primary and secondary colors. AgencyFlagItem Represents a selectable agency flag entry in the new campaign UI, binding flag name and icon to a toggle element via a data context. AgencyFlagManager Manages agency flag and color selection for the campaign creation screen, populating available flags from built-in and custom sources and tracking the selected flag icon and agency colors. AgencyMPActionData Represents multiplayer action data for an agency, including identity, action state, and associated science and mission details. AgencyManager Manages the collection of agencies within a game instance, providing registration, lookup, and lifecycle control for AgencyEntry objects. AgencyUtils Static utility class providing constants and helpers for agency configuration. AgencyUtils.TeamColorSet Represents a base and accent color pair for an agency team. AnalyticsUtils Static utility class for sending game analytics and telemetry events. AuxiliarySceneUtilities Utility methods for moving GameObjects between Unity scenes and restoring their original parent transforms. BreadcrumbsController Manages the breadcrumbs navigation UI, updating the displayed trail in response to game state and vessel changes. CampaignLoadMenu Represents the campaign load menu, managing save file entries and handling load, delete, and campaign metadata display. CampaignMenu Manages the campaign selection menu, displaying available save files and handling create, load, sort, and delete operations. CampaignPlayerEntry Represents the state and settings for a single player within a campaign, including identity, game state, active vessel, and progression data. CampaignPlayerMPActionData Represents the multiplayer action data for a campaign player, capturing identity, game state, vessel context, and synchronized field values. CampaignPlayerManager Manages the collection of campaign players and provides lookups by name, GUID, and player ID. CampaignPlayerUtil Utility methods for serializing and deserializing a campaign player's favorited parts dictionary. CampaignTileEntry Represents a single campaign tile in the campaign selection menu, binding save file data to the tile's display properties and handling tile selection. CelestialBodyAssetLoader Manages loading and unloading of local-space and scaled-space views for CelestialBodyComponent instances. CelestialBodyProvider Manages and provides access to the game's celestial body registries, including lighting, lens flares, post-processing, and ring group data. CelestialDataProvider Provides data-bound property access for a CelestialBodyComponent, exposing position, radius, atmosphere, and orbital relationship properties. CheatsMenu Represents the in-game cheats menu, providing controls for teleportation, orbital parameter overrides, and other debug state modifications. ClimbBehavior SpatialBehavior that manages a collection of ClimbInstance objects for a climbable surface, registering them with the climb system and loading their presets asynchronously. ClimbInstance Represents a climb spatial instance that holds a ClimbPresetAssetReference and initiates climbing via ClimbBehavior. ClimbPreset Represents a serializable ScriptableObject asset defining the climb flags and type for a climb preset. ClimbPresetAssetReference Represents a typed Addressable asset reference for ClimbPreset. ClimbSystem Spatial registry system for tracking ClimbInstance objects and querying neighboring instances within a given range. CommNetManager Manages the communications network connection graph, registering nodes and periodically rebuilding paths from the designated control-source node. CompareDateTime Compares two ExtendedSaveFileInfo instances by last-write time, ordering them newest first. CreateCampaignMenu Represents the create-campaign menu, managing the UI flow through sub-menus for game mode, difficulty, campaign name, agency name, and flag and color selection. DataBus<T> A base class for data binding objects that hold a typed data source and a DataContext. DeltaVToolManagerUI Pop-up UI manager for the Delta-V tool, displaying per-stage delta-V data with celestial body and altitude selection. DifficultyOptionStates A dictionary mapping difficulty option names to their current state values. DifficultyOptionsDataManager Manages difficulty option presets and their current state for a game session. DifficultyOptionsMenu Represents the difficulty options menu used when creating a new campaign, managing preset difficulty level selection and dynamically populated option toggles and sliders. DifficultyOptionsUtils Utility class providing constant keys and default values for difficulty option settings. EmptyOnPurpose Represents an intentionally empty placeholder value. ExceptionTracker Tracks runtime exceptions and displays the accumulated exception count on the game HUD. ExtendedSaveFileInfo Represents a save file entry combining a SaveFileInfo with its associated SerializedSaveGameMetadata. FlagObject Represents a plantable flag object with a cloth renderer and animation configuration for the flag-planting sequence. GameInstance Represents the central game instance, owning and coordinating all major game systems including sessions, UI, audio, scripting, and update loops. GameManager Represents the top-level singleton MonoBehaviour that orchestrates the game's startup and shutdown flow, scene transitions, and access to core subsystems. GameModeButtonContext Represents the data context for a game mode selection button, holding its display properties and the action to activate the mode. GameModeManager Manages the active game mode, loading available modes from labeled assets and providing feature and difficulty option queries for the current selection. GameModePicker Represents a UI component that presents the available game modes as selectable toggle buttons during campaign creation. GameModeUtils Utility constants for game mode identifiers and feature flag keys. GameNotifications A list of all the notification types used by the game GameStateConfiguration Represents the configuration of the current game state, including mode flags for object assembly, flight, and session status. GameStateMachine State machine that manages transitions between GameState values, coordinating camera, input locks, and UI view changes on enter and exit. GameStatesConfiguration Represents a ScriptableObject asset that stores the collection of GameStateConfiguration entries for all game states. GlobalEscapeMenu UIModule for the in-game global escape menu, displaying save, exit, and session-management options. GlobalHeaderManager UIModule for the global game header panel, switching contextual menus based on the active GameState or map mode. GlobalHeaderTimewarpManager Manages the collapsed and expanded timewarp level selector in the global header UI. InteractBehavior Represents a spatial behavior that manages a set of InteractInstance objects, loading their presets asynchronously and registering them with the interact system. InteractInstance Represents a spatial instance that supports user interaction, configured by an InteractPresetAssetReference and delegating use actions to its InteractBehavior. InteractPreset A ScriptableObject asset defining the configuration for a player interact preset. InteractPresetAssetReference Typed Addressable asset reference for an InteractPreset asset. InteractSystem Spatial registry system that evaluates registered interact instances each frame and dispatches player flight input interact actions to the best in-range target. Kerbal3DModel Represents the 3D character model of a Kerbal, building its visual appearance from variety attributes for both EVA and IVA configurations. KerbalCameraBehaviour A KerbalMonoBehaviour that manages camera behaviour for a kerbal, tracking the current camera mode, target-lock state, and orbit target. KerbalImmediateModeShapeDrawer A base class for components that draw immediate-mode shapes by hooking Camera.onPreRender to invoke DrawShapes on compatible rendering cameras. KerbalInfo Represents a Kerbal crew member, including identity, attributes, location, and enrollment data. KerbalMonoBehaviour A base class for KSP MonoBehaviours that provides convenience access to core game systems such as GameInstance, MessageCenter, and AssetProvider. KerbalPhotoBooth Manages a photo booth that poses 3D Kerbal models using character attributes and renders portrait sprites via a dedicated off-screen camera. KerbalRosterManager Manages the Kerbal roster, tracking spawned Kerbals and handling their creation, assignment, and variety. KerbalRosterManager.CustomKerbalHandlingOptions Options that control creation and reuse of veteran and non-veteran custom Kerbals. KerbalScienceMonoBehavior Base kerbal MonoBehaviour for driving science experiment polling, linked to a Module_ScienceExperiment component. KerbalVarietySystem Manages Kerbal appearance variety by loading and applying randomized name, color, attribute, and game-object-category rules from data assets. LaunchpadDialog Represents the launchpad dialog UI, which displays saved vehicles, handles vessel launch and recovery, and manages launchpad site state. LaunchpadDialogFileEntry Represents a single vehicle file entry in the launchpad dialog, displaying metadata such as name, thumbnail, part count, mass, and size. LoadOrSaveCampaignTicket Represents a request ticket that carries all parameters and state for a load-or-save campaign operation. LocalPlayer Represents the local player's identity and session state, including name, GUID, player ID, host status, and maximum player count. MapProvider Manages the game map view, coordinating map loading, mode selection, and transitions between flight map and tracking station modes. MapUICategoryHeaderExpandedState Represents the expanded state of a map UI category header, syncing a Toggle component's value to a linked MapUISelectableEntry. MissionActivationDialog Dialog for listing and activating available missions. MissionDialogEntry Represents a single entry in the training center mission dialog, wiring activate and reset buttons to their corresponding mission callbacks. NewGameSetupInfo Represents the setup configuration for a new game, including the initial difficulty level and difficulty option states. NewPlayerSetupInfo Represents the new-player setup configuration, including agency choice, agency name, colors, flag sprite location, and FTUE state. NonIVACrewCamManager Manages the pool of non-IVA seat and probe camera prefab instances used to render crew portraits outside of IVA view. NonIVASeat Represents a non-IVA crew seat, associated with a Module_CrewedInterior. NotificationData Represents display data for a single in-game notification, including tier, line items, importance, and timer settings. NotificationEvents Registers game message subscriptions and displays in-game notifications for flight and vehicle assembly editor events. NotificationLineItemData Represents the data for a single line item in a notification, including an icon, a localization key, and optional format parameters. NotificationManager Manages routing of in-game notifications to the appropriate UI provider based on notification tier. NotificationUI The positional offset applied to the content transform relative to its default position. NotificationUIAdmin Represents the admin variant of the notification UI, extending NotificationUI with an admin-specific title, body content, and icon. NotificationUIAlert Represents a UI element for displaying an alert-style in-game notification, supporting different levels of importance, timer display, and location context. NotificationUIPassive Passive variant of NotificationUI that localizes primary text and dismisses by recycling to the notification pool. NotificationUIProvider Manages the notification UI layer, handling passive, alert, and admin tier notifications using pooled prefab instances. OABProvider Provides Object Assembly Building (OAB) services, including craft assembly, launch-site management, and busy-state tracking. OABProvider.BusyInfoData Represents the busy state of an OAB session, tracking the variant, environment type, construction type, and elapsed time of an in-progress operation. PartCategoryElement Represents a part category entry in the parts manager, grouping a collection of PartElement parts under a single PartCategories value with a localized display name. PartContainersDataContext Represents a data context for a part component's resource containers, exposing part name, family, GUID, and contained resources. PartElement Represents a single part in the action group editor, exposing its display name, GUID, available actions, and selection state as a bindable ApiDataContext. PartLevelPamActions A registry of part level PAM actions that are in use PartProvider Provides access to loaded part definitions, indexed by part name. PartSymmetrySet Represents a set of symmetrically placed parts, pairing a generated integer identifier with a SymmetrySetData. PartsManagerBoolPropertyToggle Represents a poolable Parts Manager action menu entry for displaying and toggling a boolean property. Declaration public InputBinding? bindingMask { get; set; } Property Value Type Description InputBinding? Optional mask that determines which bindings in the asset to enable. Remarks Binding masks can be applied at three different levels: for an entire asset through this property, for a specific map through UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionMap.bindingMask, and for single actions through UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputAction.bindingMask. By default, none of the masks will be set (i.e. they will be null). When an action is enabled, all the binding masks that apply to it are taken into account. Specifically, this means that any given binding on the action will be enabled only if it matches the mask applied to the asset, the mask applied to the map that contains the action, and the mask applied to the action itself. All the masks are individually optional. Masks are matched against bindings using UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputBinding.Matches(UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputBinding). Note that if you modify the masks applicable to an action while it is enabled, the action's UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputAction.controls will get updated immediately to respect the mask. To avoid repeated binding resolution, it is most efficient to apply binding masks before enabling actions. Binding masks are non-destructive. All the bindings on the action are left in place. Setting a mask will not affect the value of the UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputAction.bindings and UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionMap.bindings properties. See Also MaskByGroup(string) bindingMask bindingMask bindings Iterate over all bindings in the asset. Declaration public IEnumerable<InputBinding> bindings { get; } Property Value Type Description IEnumerable<InputBinding> Remarks This iterates over all action maps in UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionAsset.actionMaps and, within each map, over the set of UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionMap.bindings. See Also bindings controlSchemes List of control schemes defined in the asset. Declaration public ReadOnlyArray<InputControlScheme> controlSchemes { get; } Property Value Type Description ReadOnlyArray<InputControlScheme> Control schemes defined for the asset. See Also AddControlScheme(InputActionAsset, string) RemoveControlScheme(InputActionAsset, string) devices Set of devices that bindings in the asset can bind to. Declaration public ReadOnlyArray<InputDevice>? devices { get; set; } Property Value Type Description ReadOnlyArray<InputDevice>? Optional set of devices to use by bindings in the asset. Remarks By default (with this property being null), bindings will bind to any of the controls available through UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputSystem.devices, i.e. controls from all devices in the system will be used. By setting this property, binding resolution can instead be restricted to just specific devices. This restriction can either be applied to an entire asset using this property or to specific action maps by using UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionMap.devices. Note that if both this property and UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionMap.devices is set for a specific action map, the list of devices on the action map will take precedence and the list on the asset will be ignored for bindings in that action map. // Create an asset with a single action map and a single action with a // gamepad binding. var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<InputActionAsset>(); var actionMap = new InputActionMap(); var fireAction = actionMap.AddAction("Fire", binding: "<Gamepad>/buttonSouth"); asset.AddActionMap(actionMap); // Let's assume we have two gamepads connected. If we enable the // action map now, the 'Fire' action will bind to both. actionMap.Enable(); // This will print two controls. Debug.Log(string.Join("\n", fireAction.controls)); // To restrict the setup to just the first gamepad, we can assign // to the 'devices' property (in this case, we could do so on either // the action map or on the asset; we choose the latter here). asset.devices = new InputDevice[] { Gamepad.all[0] }; // Now this will print only one control. Debug.Log(string.Join("\n", fireAction.controls)); See Also devices Methods Contains(InputAction) Return true if the given action is part of the asset. Declaration public InputAction FindAction(string actionNameOrId, bool throwIfNotFound = false) Parameters Type Name Description string actionNameOrId Name of the action as either a "map/action" combination (e.g. "gameplay/fire") or a simple name (e.g. "fire"). In the former case, the name is split at the '/' slash and the first part is used to find a map with that name and the second part is used to find an action with that name inside the map. In the latter case, all maps are searched in order and the first action that has the given name in any of the maps is returned. Note that name comparisons are case-insensitive. Alternatively, the given string can be a GUID as given by <xref href="UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputAction.id" data-throw-if-not-resolved="false"></xref>. bool throwIfNotFound If true, instead of returning null when the action cannot be found, throw ArgumentException. Returns Type Description InputAction The action with the corresponding name or null if no matching action could be found. Remarks Note that no lookup structures are used internally to speed the operation up. Instead, the search is done linearly. For repeated access of an action, it is thus generally best to look up actions once ahead of time and cache the result. If multiple actions have the same name and actionNameOrId is not an ID and not an action name qualified by a map name (that is, in the form of "mapName/actionName"), the action that is returned will be from the first map in UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionAsset.actionMaps that has an action with the given name. An exception is if, of the multiple actions with the same name, some are enabled and some are disabled. In this case, the first action that is enabled is returned. If an action name contains a slash "/", e.g. "yaw/pitch" and there is also a map called "yaw" which contains an action "pitch", the action "pitch" within the map "yaw" will be returned instead of the action named "yaw/pitch". var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<InputActionAsset>(); var map1 = new InputActionMap("map1"); var map2 = new InputActionMap("map2"); asset.AddActionMap(map1); asset.AddActionMap(map2); var action1 = map1.AddAction("action1"); var action2 = map1.AddAction("action2"); var action3 = map2.AddAction("action3"); // Search all maps in the asset for any action that has the given name. asset.FindAction("action1") // Returns action1. asset.FindAction("action2") // Returns action2 asset.FindAction("action3") // Returns action3. // Search for a specific action in a specific map. asset.FindAction("map1/action1") // Returns action1. asset.FindAction("map2/action2") // Returns action2. asset.FindAction("map3/action3") // Returns action3. // Search by unique action ID. asset.FindAction(action1.id.ToString()) // Returns action1. asset.FindAction(action2.id.ToString()) // Returns action2. asset.FindAction(action3.id.ToString()) // Returns action3. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Messages.PropertyWatc.summary: Namespace KSP.Messages.PropertyWatchers Classes ActiveCameraGroupPropertyWatcher A CameraPropertyWatcher that tracks the active camera group property. ActiveVehicleTargetCelestialBody Represents a property watcher that reports the name of the celestial body targeted by the active vehicle. CameraGimbalDistancePropertyWatcher A CameraGimbalPropertyWatcher that reports the distance in meters of the camera from its gimbal origin. CameraGimbalHeadingPropertyWatcher A CameraGimbalPropertyWatcher that reports the camera gimbal heading as left-right rotation in degrees around the gimbal Y axis. CameraGimbalPitchPropertyWatcher Represents a property watcher for the camera gimbal pitch, tracking up/down rotation in degrees around the gimbal's X axis. CameraGimbalPropertyWatcher A CameraPropertyWatcher that tracks the active camera gimbal state. CameraLocalPitchPropertyWatcher Watches the local pitch angle, in degrees, of the active camera gimbal. CameraLocalRollPropertyWatcher A CameraGimbalPropertyWatcher that reports camera roll in degrees around the forward (Z) axis, increasing clockwise. CameraLocalYawPropertyWatcher A CameraGimbalPropertyWatcher that tracks the local yaw of the camera, expressed as left/right rotation in degrees within the camera's local coordinate system. CameraPropertyWatcher A PropertyWatcher for camera-related game properties that is valid when the session manager is available. CameraUnderWaterPropertyWatcher A CameraPropertyWatcher that reports whether the camera is currently below the water surface. CelestialBodyContextMenuOpened Represents a property watcher that tracks the name of the last celestial body for which the right-click context menu was opened. CelestialBodyDiscoveredPropertyWatcher A GamePropertyWatcher for the most recently discovered celestial body. CelestialBodySelected Represents a property watcher that reports the name of the celestial body selected in Map View. CelestialBodyTarget A VehiclePropertyWatcher that reports the name of the active vessel's main body when it matches the configured mission destination celestial body. CrewCount A VehiclePropertyWatcher that reports the current number of Kerbals aboard the active vessel. CurrentGameStatePropertyWatcher A GamePropertyWatcher that exposes the current GameState as a discoverable property. CurrentScienceAvailable A VehiclePropertyWatcher that reports the science points currently available to the local player. EVAKerbalSituationPropertyWatcher A GamePropertyWatcher that tracks the current situation of an EVA Kerbal, such as landed, in water, in atmosphere, or in orbit. EVAPropertyWatcher A PropertyWatcher specialized for monitoring EVA-related game properties. ElectricChargeProductionRate A VehiclePropertyWatcher that reports the total electric charge production rate for the active vessel. ElectricityLevel Represents a property watcher that reports the active vessel's electricity level as a percentage of its total capacity. EscapeTrajectorySOIPredictedPropertyWatcher Represents a VehiclePropertyWatcher that reports the name of the celestial body whose sphere of influence the active vehicle's trajectory is predicted to enter. FlightPropertyWatcher A PropertyWatcher that is valid only when an active vessel with a telemetry data provider is present. FlightVehicleAltitudeDiffFromPosition A FlightPropertyWatcher that reports the difference in altitude between the active vessel and a mission-defined position on a celestial body. FlightVehicleDistanceFromPosition Represents a flight property watcher that computes the distance from the active vessel to a mission-defined position on a celestial body. FlightVehicleLatitudeDiffFromPosition Represents a property watcher for the latitude difference between the active vessel and a position on a celestial body set by a mission action. FlightVehicleLongitudeDiffFromPosition Represents a flight property watcher that computes the longitude difference between the active vehicle and a position on a celestial body set by a mission action. GamePropertyWatcher A PropertyWatcher that is valid when a game instance with an initialized global game state is available. HasBeenToResearchLocation Represents a vehicle property watcher that indicates whether the active vessel has been to a given research location. HasCommand A VehiclePropertyWatcher that reports whether the active vessel has a command module. HasPart A VehiclePropertyWatcher that tracks whether the active vessel contains a specific part. HasPartInGroup Represents a vehicle property watcher that checks whether a vessel has a specific part in a VAB family group. HasScoredResearchReport A VehiclePropertyWatcher that tracks whether a specified mission research report has been scored. HasStoredResearchLocation Represents a vehicle property watcher that indicates whether a specific research location is stored on the current vehicle. HasStoredResearchLocationOnActiveVessel HasStoredResearchReport Represents a vehicle property watcher that indicates whether a specific research report is stored on the current vehicle. InputHeldPitchDownDuration Tracks the elapsed hold duration, in seconds, of the pitch-down flight input, resetting to zero when the input is released. InputHeldPitchUpDuration Represents a flight property watcher that tracks the duration in seconds the pitch-up input has been held. InputHeldRollLeftDuration Represents a flight property watcher that tracks how long, in seconds, the roll-left input has been held. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Messages.html.title: Namespace KSP.Messages | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Messages.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Messages Classes AblatorAvailableMessage Represents a message indicating that a vessel's heat shield has ablator remaining. AbortTutorial Represents the message sent when the player aborts the current tutorial. ActionBlockedByTimeWarpMessage Represents a message sent when an action is blocked by time warp. ActionBlockedByTimeWarpPausedMessage Represents a message sent when an action is blocked because time warp is paused. ActionGroupCreatedMessage Message published when the player creates an action group in the object assembly building. ActionGroupManagerOpenedMessage Represents a message sent when the Action Group Manager is opened. ActionGroupMappingChanged Represents a message sent when an action group mapping changes. ActiveManeuverNodeReachedMessage Represents a message fired when the time to reach the active maneuver node is zero. ActiveVesselDestroyedMessage Represents a message published when the active vessel is destroyed. AddVesselToMapMessage Represents a message requesting that a vessel be added to the map view. AssemblyActionGroupsChanged Represents a message sent when the action groups of an ObjectAssembly change. AssemblyMassChangedMessage Message sent when the mass of an object assembly changes. AudioCueMessage A base class for audio cue event messages. AuthenticationMessageBase A base class for authentication-related messages. AutoModeCameraContextMessage Represents the camera context used when the camera is placed in auto mode. BackToKSCMessage Message broadcast when players return to the Kerbal Space Center. BlueprintModeEnabledMessage Represents the message fired when blueprint mode is enabled by clicking on the view cube in the OAB. CFXSMessageBase A base class for CFXS messages carrying a group and instance identifier. CalculateAllStagesDVForSituation Represents a message that requests delta-V calculations for all stages under a specified situation. CalculateStageDVForSituation Represents a message requesting delta-V calculation for a specific stage under a given DeltaVSituation. CameraChangedMessage Represents a message sent when the player switches camera views. CameraFOVChangedMessage Represents a message sent when the camera field of view is changed. CameraFocusedMessage Represents a message fired when the camera is focused on a part in the OAB. CameraManagerUpdatedUnityTransform Represents a message broadcast when the camera manager updates its Unity transform in response to a floating origin reset. CameraMessageBase A base class for camera-related messages. CameraModeChangedMessage Represents a message broadcast when the active camera mode changes. CameraModeKeyMessage Represents a message fired when the camera mode key is activated. CameraMovedVerticallyMessage Represents a message raised when the camera is moved vertically. CameraOrbitTargetChangedMessage Represents a message broadcast when the camera orbit target changes. CameraPQSChangedMessage Represents a message fired when the camera's observed PQS planet changes. CameraPannedMessage Represents a message dispatched when the player pans the camera. CameraResetMessage Message sent when the player resets the camera via input. CameraRotatedMessage Message dispatched when the player rotates the camera. CameraZoomedMessage Represents a message dispatched when the player zooms the camera. CanObserverLeaveActiveVesselValueChangedMessage Represents a message broadcast when the value indicating whether an observer can leave the active vessel changes. CelestialBodiesLoadedMessage Represents the message fired when all celestial bodies have been loaded. CelestialBodyContextOpenedMessage Represents a message fired when the context menu is opened on a celestial body. CelestialBodyDataAddedMessage Represents a message published when celestial body data is added, carrying the body's rendering, lighting, and atmosphere configuration. CelestialBodyDataRemovedMessage Represents a message published when a celestial body's rendering data is removed. CelestialBodyDiscoveredMessage Represents a message raised when a celestial body is discovered by the player. CelestialBodyLocalSpaceLoadedMessage Represents a message sent when a celestial body's local space has been loaded. CelestialBodyMessageBase A base class for celestial body messages. CenterOfPressureToggledOnMessage Represents the message raised when the OAB center of pressure display is toggled on. CenterOfThrustToggledOnMessage Represents the message fired when the OAB center of thrust button is toggled on. CloseDeltaVToolWindow Message that requests the Delta-V Tool window to be closed. CloseEngineersReportWindowMessage Message published when the close button on the Engineers Report window is clicked. ClosedDeltaVToolWindow Represents the message raised when the player closes the DeltaV Tool window. ColonyControlChangedMessage Represents a message fired when colony control changes. ColonyDataUpdatedMessage Message sent when colony data has been updated. ColonyDeployedMessage Represents a message raised when a colony is deployed. ColonyEstablishedMessage Represents a message published when a colony is established. ColonyFoundedMessage Represents a message published when a colony is founded. ColonyMessageBase A base class for colony-related messages. CommandStatusChangedMessage Represents a message broadcast when the control state of a command module changes. ControlPointChangedMessage Flight message sent when a part component's active control point changes. ControlSelectedVesselMessage Represents a message dispatched when the player takes control of the currently selected vessel. ControlSurfaceAdded Message sent when a control surface is added in the OAB editor. ControlSurfaceDeleted Represents a message broadcast when a control surface is deleted from the assembly. ControlsMessageBase A base class for controls-related messages. CreditScreenEnteredMessage Represents a message dispatched when the user enters the credit screen. CreditScreenExitedMessage Represents the message published when the user exits the credit screen. DebugNotificationMessage Represents a debug notification message displayed from the log console window. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Navigation.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Navigation Classes ADynamicNavLayout Abstract base class for a dynamic navigation layout that manages selectable element groups, focus state, load lifecycle, and cursor synchronization. CanvasNavLayout A ADynamicNavLayout that drives navigation from a Unity Canvas and implements INavElementRegister to support layout tagging. DraggableTag Represents a draggable navigation tag that activates the mouse cursor when a drag operation begins. DropdownLayout Represents a navigation layout for a TMPro.TMP_Dropdown, managing its expanded items within the KSP UI navigation system. DynamicGroup A HierachyGroup that caches accessible SelectableElementInfo entries using a dirty flag, refreshing the lists lazily when elements are added, removed, or changed. DynamicGroupExtension Extension methods for attaching and retrieving a DynamicGroup(Extend<NavElementGroup>) decorator on NavElementGroup instances. GamepadClickLayoutTrigger MonoBehaviour that loads the target INavigatable layout via Navigator when a gamepad submit pointer click is received. HierachyGroup Decorator for a NavElementGroup that organizes navigation element groups into a parent-child hierarchy. HierachyGroupExtension Extension methods for attaching and managing HierachyGroup(Extend<NavElementGroup>) decorators on NavElementGroup instances. MainCameraElementTag Component tag that registers a UI UnityEngine.UI.Selectable with an IMainCameraSelectableRegister navigation layout on start, retrying until the element is accepted or the timeout elapses. MainCameraNavLayout Dynamic navigation layout bound to the main camera, implementing selectable and navigation element registration for the main camera viewport. NavElementGroup Represents a group of navigable UI UnityEngine.UI.Selectable elements with a typed extension point. NavElementTag Registers a UnityEngine.UI.Selectable with the navigator group and attaches supplementary navigation components for slider and dropdown elements. NavigationExtension Extension methods for UI navigation, providing array containment, float clamping, and direction-based selectable element resolution. NavigationTags Tag string constants identifying UI navigation layouts and screens. Navigator Represents the global UI navigation controller, managing a stack of INavigatable layouts and routing gamepad input actions to the active layout. NavigatorExtensiion Extension methods for cycling an integer index or enum value forward and backward with wrap-around. QuickNavAccessTag Component that registers a UI element as a quick-navigation access point in a named layout, adding the entry on Start and removing it on destroy. QuickNavigationLayout Navigation layout that maintains per-direction lists of QuickNavigationLayout.QuickAccess entries and routes directional input to the nearest selectable UI element. Scrollable Decorator for a NavElementGroup that manages scroll state, boundary tracking, and animated scrolling to selectable elements. ScrollableElementGroup A NavElementGroup that adds automatic scrolling behavior to its navigable elements. ScrollableExtension Extension methods for adding or retrieving a Scrollable(Extend<NavElementGroup>) decorator on a NavElementGroup. ScrolledDynamicGroup A DynamicGroup that restricts accessible navigation elements to those visible within a scroll rect boundary. ScrolledDynamicGroupExtension Extension methods for attaching and retrieving the ScrolledDynamicGroup(Extend<NavElementGroup>) decorator on NavElementGroup targets. SliderTag Represents a navigation tag component that enables gamepad control of an attached UnityEngine.UI.Slider, handling focus management, incremental value adjustment, submission, and cancellation. StagingPanelNavElementTag Represents a tag component that registers a staging panel UnityEngine.UI.Selectable with the active navigation layout hierarchy on startup. StagingPanelQuickNavAccessTag Registers a UI element as a quick navigation access point in the staging panel's navigation layout, using either a selectable component or a RectTransform range. Structs ElementInfoMatch Represents the scoring state and best-candidate result for a directional UI navigation match. NavigationParameter Represents the tunable parameters that control navigation target selection behavior. QuickNavigationLayout.QuickAccess Represents a quick-access entry associating a directional selection origin with a target layout and selectable element. SelectableElementInfo Represents a selectable UI or world element within a navigation group, providing screen-space position and size data. Interfaces ICameraProvider Interface for objects that provide a Camera. IHierachyGroupsLayout Interface for a navigation layout that organizes items into hierarchy groups. IMainCameraSelectableRegister Interface for registering and unregistering UI selectables with the main camera's navigation system. INavElementRegister Interface for navigation elements that can be registered with a layout tag. INavigatable Interface for UI panels that support directional keyboard and controller navigation between selectable elements. INavigationLayout Interface for a navigation layout that exposes its Unity transform. INavigator Interface for a navigator that loads, unloads, and tracks navigatable layouts and manages UI input state. IQuickNavRegister Interface for registering quick-navigation access points in specific move directions. IScrollable Interface for objects that can receive and handle scroll input. ISyncCursorPosition Interface for synchronizing the cursor position. Enums LoadType The condition that determines when a navigation element is loaded. Navigator.InputType Input action categories that can be individually enabled or disabled on the navigator. SelectPoint Cardinal directions for selecting a navigation point. SelectionPriorityMode The priority strategy applied when determining which navigation target to select.

AllPlayersPlayingButMe Routing target representing all players currently in the game session except the local player. AllPlayersPlayingButOne Routing target representing all players currently in the game session except one specified player. AllPlayersPlayingInAgency Routing target representing all players in the game session who belong to the same agency as the sender. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Rendering.Planets.htm.title: Namespace KSP.Rendering.Planets | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Rendering.Planets.htm.summary: Namespace KSP.Rendering.Planets Classes AddLandBasedUnderWaterEffect Represents a component that applies the land-based underwater visual effect within a box-collider-defined region, including caustics, water depth, and back-surface rendering driven by camera submersion detection. AtmosphereScatterManager Manages atmosphere scattering model loading and post-process rendering for planets in flight and map views. BiomeLookupHashTable Represents a spatial hash table used to look up biome surface data by UV coordinate on a planetary surface. BiomePhysicsMapping Represents a mapping between KSP2 biome types and their associated Unity physics materials. BiomePhysicsPair Represents a pairing of a KSP2 biome type and an associated physics material. ClearWaterDepthAction Represents a late-update action that clears the water depth buffer by invoking a configurable callback, implementing ILateUpdate and IPriorityOverride. DrawLandBasedWaterAction Represents a late-update action that triggers land-based water rendering during the planetary rendering pipeline. DrawOceanAction Represents a late-update handler that triggers ocean rendering by invoking a registered callback each frame. OceanQuadMeshGenerator Generates quad mesh geometry for planetary ocean surfaces. OceanUpdateAction Late-update action that fires a registered callback to trigger ocean rendering updates. PQData Represents the runtime data for a planet quad-sphere, including subdivision thresholds, tessellation parameters, and native quad collections. PQJob Static container for planetary quad subdivision job types and utility structs used in planet surface rendering. PQS Represents a Procedural Quad Sphere (PQS) planet-terrain component, managing quad subdivision, physics generation, and rendering for a celestial body. PQS.StatCollection Represents a collection of PQS.Stats tracking frame-level, average, and peak quad statistics for a PQS sphere. PQS.Stats Represents quad statistics for a PQS sphere over a single frame or reporting period. PQSCollider Represents a mesh collider instance for a single PQS terrain quad. PQSColliderPool Manages a pool of PQSCollider instances for planet quad-surface mesh collision. PQSColliderRequest Represents a pending async GPU readback request for PQS collider vertex data, holding the associated compute buffer and native arrays for a terrain quad batch. PQSData The string tags corresponding to each biome channel index ("R", "G", "B", "A"). PQSData.BiomeData Stores per-channel biome mapping arrays for the Red, Green, Blue, and Alpha channels of a planet's biome mask texture. PQSData.BiomeMappingData Maps a biome color channel entry to a PQSData.KSP2BiomeType and texture index. PQSData.HeightMapInfo Stores global and local height map configuration for a planet, including displacement scale, filtering modes, pole distortion settings, and per-zone height regions. PQSData.HeightRegion Represents a localized height region defined by a height map, UV scale, height displacement, and optional sub-zone filter values. PQSData.MaterialSettings Holds the material and shader settings used for rendering a planet's surface and scaled-space representation. PQSData.PoleDecalParameters Parameters for procedural pole smoothing applied near a planet's pole. PQSData.PoleHeightSettings Represents the height decal parameters for both north and south poles of a planet. PQSDataSubZones Stores PQS sub-zone rendering data, including a normal texture array and index mappings for up to four sub-zones. PQSGeometry Manages the cached mesh geometry used by PQS terrain quad patches, including vertex positions and triangle index arrays for all edge interpolation states. PQSGlobalSettings Represents global configuration settings for the PQS planet-rendering system, including subdivision and collider parameters. PQSGlobalSettings.SubdivData Holds subdivision level bounds and terrain tessellation parameters for a PQS planet. PQSGlobalSettings.SubdivisionInfo Holds subdivision threshold multipliers and computes the per-level subdivision, collapse, and physics thresholds for a PQS instance. PQSGlobeDisplay Renders a configurable wireframe latitude/longitude grid overlay on a PQS planet sphere. PQSJobUtil Utility methods for PQS rendering jobs, including spherical UV coordinate computation and height sampling. PQSQuadTest A test MonoBehaviour that identifies the current PQS quad plane and displays positional debug information on screen. PQSQuadTest.Quad Represents a single face of a cube-sphere, storing the face transform matrix and its inverse. PQSRenderer Count of new quads added in the most recent update, exposed for debug inspection. PQSRendererHelper API for reading per-biome properties from a PQS Material and uploading them to structured graphics buffers. PQSTargetProvider Provides camera and observer position and direction data in the local coordinate space of a PQS body transform. PQSTestCameraManager Manages a test camera rig for the PQS planetary rendering system. PrevisCameraManager Manages camera configuration and scene setup for planet rendering preview scenes in the Unity Editor. ShaderRefactorProfile Describes how PQSRenderer should drive a given ShaderRefactorState: which shader the planet material uses, the base shader pass offset, and which modern-pipeline features are active. Routing every renderer decision through a profile keeps the per-variant behaviour in one table instead of scattered == Standard checks, so adding a variant is a single enum value plus a single table entry. VolumeCloudManager Manages volumetric cloud rendering for planetary bodies, tracking loaded cloud models and post-process effects across flight and map views. WaitWaterDetectionAction Represents a late-update action that defers a callback invocation while waiting for water detection during planet rendering. WaterInitPerFrameAction Represents a per-frame late-update action that invokes a registered callback during water initialization. WaterManager Output array receiving the world-space water surface position for each submerged object. WaterManager.WaterDetectEntry Represents a registered entry tracking the underwater state and water surface position of an WaterManager.IWaterDetectObject. Structs BiomeLookupHashCell Represents a single cell in a biome lookup hash, storing the biome chunk indices mapped to that cell. CreateQuadDataJob A Burst-compiled parallel job that populates GPU quad data for each planet quad patch. CreateQuadStatesJob Represents a Burst-compiled job that applies pending state changes to a collection of QuadState entries. CreateUpdateListsJob Represents a Burst-compiled parallel job that populates mesh creation, normal update, visibility, and collider update lists for planetary quads. HeightSampleRequest Represents a request to sample the height at a point on a planetary surface, identified by a direction vector and UV coordinates. InterestGroup Represents a spherical region of interest defined by a world-space center position and a radius. OceanFeature Represents ocean rendering feature settings, including spectrum precision, foam, and underwater god ray quality. PQData.TesselationPositionData Represents a position and height offset for a planet surface tessellation sample. PQJob.PQ Represents a single node in the planetary quad subdivision tree, including adjacency links, transform matrices, and rendering state. PQJob.PQSJobHolder Holds a scheduled Unity job instance and its associated JobHandle. PQS.MicroSplatLight Represents a light source passed to the MicroSplat terrain rendering system. PQS.MicroSplatShadow Represents shadow data passed to the MicroSplat terrain rendering system. PQSColliderInfo Represents collider information for a PQS terrain quad, including the quad index, relative position, and pooled collider index. PQSData.BiomeSurfaceData Represents the surface biome type and associated color for a biome lookup entry. PQSRenderer.GenerateOceanSphereVertsJob Burst-compiled parallel job that transforms ocean sphere vertices into world-space positions and computes face-north matrices. PQSRenderer.GenerateOceanVertsJob Burst-compiled parallel job that projects ocean quad vertices onto the planet sphere and outputs world-space positions, planar coordinates, sphere UVs, and face-north matrices. PerBiomeInfo Represents per-biome rendering data, including small-scale texture configurations and height-based blending parameters. PerBiomeInfo_Subzones Represents per-biome small-scale texture configuration for up to four subzones. PerBiomeSmallScaleTextureConfig Represents the per-biome configuration parameters for small-scale terrain texture rendering. PerBiomeSmallScaleTextureConfig_Subzones Represents the small-scale texture subzone configuration for a single biome, including per-channel tints, brightness, and blend weights. PositionCollidersJob Represents a Burst-compiled parallel job that positions colliders by transforming offset positions from reference space to world space. QuadDataGPU Represents GPU-side data for a single planetary quad, including transform matrices, position data, and index identifiers. QuadMeshData Represents the per-vertex mesh data for a planetary terrain quad. QuadState Represents the change state of a planet terrain quad, tracking whether it is new, has modified edges, has collapsed, or has subdivided. WaterManager.UnderLandBasedWaterDetectJob Burst-compiled parallel job that tests whether objects are submerged within a land-based box-shaped water region. WaterManager.UnderWaterDetectJob Burst-compiled parallel job that tests whether objects are submerged beneath a spherical ocean surface. Interfaces IPQSOverlay Interface for a PQS overlay that provides an overlay material for planet surface rendering. IPQSRenderer Interface for a planet quad sphere renderer that responds to PQS update notifications. IPQSTerrainBlocker Interface for a PQS terrain blocker that provides mesh renderers used during the depth rendering pass. WaterManager.IWaterDetectObject Interface for objects that can be queried for position and body data during underwater detection. Enums DebugBiome Represents the color channels used to visualize biome debug data on planetary surfaces. DebugTriplanar Debug rendering mode for triplanar texture projection on planet surfaces. EdgeState Flags representing which edges of a planet terrain tile have active interpolation. OceanQuality Quality levels for ocean rendering. OceanSpectrumPrecision Precision level for ocean spectrum rendering calculations. PQSData.FilteringMode Texture filtering mode applied to height map sampling. PQSData.KSP2BiomeType Identifies the surface biome type used for physics material and texture selection on a planet. PQSRenderer.OceanType Represents the type of ocean surface rendered on a planet. QI The six axis-aligned face directions of a planet cube-sphere. QuadChild The directional child quadrant of a planetary terrain quad. QuadEdge The edge of a planet-surface quad, identified by cardinal direction. QuadPlane The axis-aligned face of a cube sphere on which a planetary quad is rendered. ShaderRefactorState Selects which planet rendering shader variant PQSRenderer drives. The per-variant behaviour (which shader, pass offset, and pipeline features) is described by ShaderRefactorProfile. UnderWaterGodRayQuality Quality levels for the underwater god ray rendering effect. Delegates PQS.OnEvent Callback delegate for PQS sphere events.

Inheritance object LuaScriptUtilityMgr Namespace: KSP.ScriptInterop Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public static class LuaScriptUtilityMgr Remarks The console lives in a SpaceWarp package that cannot reference this game assembly, so it drives script runs by reflecting these static methods by name. The real state lives in ScriptRunRegistry. The Lua surface this manager used to register (Input, Script, Log, Wait, Files) moved to the contributed libraries in Redux.Lua. Do not rename or change these signatures without updating the console's reflection in SpaceWarpConsoleLuaService. Methods BeginScriptRun(string, string, string) Opens a run and returns its id. A blank id is replaced with a generated one. Returns Type Description string The run id, generated when none was supplied. CancelScriptRun(string) Cancels a run and stops every coroutine it started. Declaration public static bool CancelScriptRun(string runId) Parameters Type Name Description string runId The run id to cancel. Returns Type Description bool True if a run with that id existed. ClearCurrentScriptRun(string) Clears the current run if it matches the given id. Declaration public static void ClearCurrentScriptRun(string runId) Parameters Type Name Description string runId The run id to clear. CompleteScriptRun(string) Closes a run's top-level body. The run stays "active" while it still owns running coroutines. Declaration public static void CompleteScriptRun(string runId) Parameters Type Name Description string runId The run id to complete. IsScriptRunActive(string) Whether a run is still going: its body is registered and not cancelled, or it still owns coroutines. Declaration public static bool IsScriptRunActive(string runId) Parameters Type Name Description string runId The run id to test. Returns Type Description bool True while the run or any coroutine it started is alive. SetCurrentScriptRun(string) Marks the given run as the one currently executing, so the Script global reads from it. Declaration public static void SetCurrentScriptRun(string runId) Parameters Type Name Description string runId The run id to make current.

Namespace: KSP.Sim Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public enum CameraMode : byte Fields Name Description Auto Camera mode selected automatically based on the current flight context. Body Camera mode that locks the view to the vessel body frame. Capture Camera mode used during orbital rendezvous or capture operations. Celestial Camera mode that orients the view relative to the celestial sphere. Chase Camera mode that follows behind the vessel along its direction of travel. Cinematic Cinematic camera mode for scripted or dramatic camera presentation. Horizon Camera mode aligned to the local planetary horizon. Namespace: KSP.Sim.Definitions Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public enum AttachNodeMethod Fields Name Description FIXED_JOINT Attaches the node using a fixed joint that prevents all relative movement between parts. HINGE_JOINT Attaches the node using a hinge joint that permits rotation around a single axis. LOCKED_JOINT Attaches the node using a locked joint that constrains all degrees of freedom. MERGED_PHYSICS Attaches the node by merging the part's physics simulation with that of its parent. NONE No attachment method; the node carries no physics connection. NO_PHYSICS Attaches the node without applying any physics simulation to the part. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.Definitions.PartM.summary: Struct PartModuleResourceSetting Represents a resource configuration entry for a part module, specifying the resource name, consumption or production rate, and acceptance threshold. Namespace: KSP.Sim.Definitions Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public struct PartModuleResourceSetting Fields AcceptanceThreshold The minimum fraction of the requested resource flow that must be satisfied for the transfer to be considered acceptable. DeltaVExtensions API for delta-V staging queries, mode detection, and situation-based value selection. DeltaVPartInfo.PartStageFuelMass.PartResources Holds the resource container group and tracks consumed resource units for a part during a staging phase. DeltaVPropellantInfo Represents propellant availability and burn-time data for a single propellant type within a vessel delta-V calculation. Namespace: KSP.Sim Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public enum PatchTransitionType Fields Name Description Collision A transition in which the vessel impacts the surface of a celestial body. CompletelyOutOfFuel A transition in which all propellant is exhausted and no further thrust is possible. Encounter A transition in which the vessel enters the sphere of influence of another body. EndThrust A transition marking the point at which a thrust arc ends. Escape A transition in which the vessel exits the sphere of influence of the current body. Final The last patch at the end of a trajectory simulation with no further transition. Initial The starting patch at the beginning of a trajectory simulation. Maneuver A transition caused by a planned maneuver node. PartialOutOfFuel A transition in which one or more propellant stages are exhausted but thrust continues on remaining stages. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.impl.CollisionMan.title: Class CollisionManager | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.impl.CollisionMan.summary: Class CollisionManager Manage PhysX interactions to ignore collisions between colliders in the same vessel. The primary mechanism for this is Physics.IgnoreCollision(). However, doing that for every collider combination scales O(n^2). Scalability problems become measurable around 100 parts, and can take several minutes after 900+ parts. It is much faster to only set up ignores for parts that are actually touching. This scales close to O(n) with the collider count. However, it's difficult to test this in advance. So we just let PhysX tell us which are touching, because that's what it's designed to do. Record each collider as being "owned" by a vessel (guid) Wait for PhysX to report a contact. CollisionMonitor receives a Physics.ContactModifyEvent for the contact. (The callback is offthread) If the contact is between to colliders owned by the same vessel GUID, void the contact. (This allows them to pass through as if already ignored) Log the contact in a thread-safe structure. At some later point on the main thread, read the log, set do the Physics.IgnoreCollision(), and (optionally) log again so that it can be undone. There are some cases that require special handling: Collider setups that won't generate Physics.ContactModifyEvent() callbacks (usually because they are temporarily on the same Rigidbody), but need to be ignored anyway. It is necessary to call Physics.IgnoreCollision() in advance. ("always ignore") Some ignores need to persist despite the collider being removed from the vessel. ("persist after removal"). This is usually a separable item (e.g., engine shroud) significantly overlaps other colliders (e.g., the engine it contains). If the ignore is removed too soon, the resulting contact event can lead to RUD. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.impl.VesselSituat.summary: Enum VesselSituations Represents the flight situation of a vessel. Namespace: KSP.Sim.impl Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public enum VesselSituations : byte Fields Name Description Escaping The vessel is on a hyperbolic escape trajectory away from a body. Flying The vessel is in atmospheric flight above a body. Landed The vessel is resting on the surface of a body. Orbiting The vessel is in a closed orbit around a body. PreLaunch The vessel is on the pad or runway before launch. Splashed The vessel is floating in a body of water. SubOrbital The vessel is on a sub-orbital trajectory that will intersect the surface. Unknown The vessel situation could not be determined. CollisionManager Manage PhysX interactions to ignore collisions between colliders in the same vessel. The primary mechanism for this is Physics.IgnoreCollision(). However, doing that for every collider combination scales O(n^2). Scalability problems become measurable around 100 parts, and can take several minutes after 900+ parts. It is much faster to only set up ignores for parts that are actually touching. This scales close to O(n) with the collider count. However, it's difficult to test this in advance. So we just let PhysX tell us which are touching, because that's what it's designed to do. Record each collider as being "owned" by a vessel (guid) Wait for PhysX to report a contact. CollisionMonitor receives a Physics.ContactModifyEvent for the contact. (The callback is offthread) If the contact is between to colliders owned by the same vessel GUID, void the contact. (This allows them to pass through as if already ignored) Log the contact in a thread-safe structure. At some later point on the main thread, read the log, set do the Physics.IgnoreCollision(), and (optionally) log again so that it can be undone. There are some cases that require special handling: Collider setups that won't generate Physics.ContactModifyEvent() callbacks (usually because they are temporarily on the same Rigidbody), but need to be ignored anyway. It is necessary to call Physics.IgnoreCollision() in advance. ("always ignore") Some ignores need to persist despite the collider being removed from the vessel. ("persist after removal"). This is usually a separable item (e.g., engine shroud) significantly overlaps other colliders (e.g., the engine it contains). If the ignore is removed too soon, the resulting contact event can lead to RUD. CollisionMarker An OrbitMarker that marks the collision transition point on a patched orbit. FlagSiteUIManager Manages the in-flight flag-planting UI, handling site name and description input and coordinating input locks while the panel is visible. FlightControlInstrument A flight control HUD instrument that binds the view data provider context to its bind root during initialization. FlightHUDWorldLabelsInstrument Flight HUD instrument that pools and renders world-space labels for nearby vessels and waypoints. FlightReportCrewItem Represents a single crew member entry in the flight report UI, displaying the crew icon and name. FlightReportResearchItem Represents a single research item entry in the flight report UI, displaying an icon, title, and point value. FlightReportUIManager Manages the flight report UI panel displayed after a flight ends, aggregating sections for research, crew, logs, records, and mission status messages. FlightStagingStackInstrument Flight HUD instrument for the staging stack display, using FlightStagingUIDriver to manage staging UI and subscribing to delta-V and engine-mode change messages. FlightWidgetManager A base class for flight UI widget managers that depend on an IViewController backend and update when the active vessel changes. FunctionMenuInstrument A flight HUD instrument for the function menu, extending UIFlightHUDInstrument and binding the view data context on initialization. GameView Represents the root flight UI game view instrument, managing canvas visibility and mode transitions across flight, map, and tracking station views. GoButtonInstrument Flight HUD instrument for the go button, connecting a UIWidget_GoButton to the staging data provider. HACK_UIMouseover Hack MonoBehaviour that spawns a HACK_UIMouseoverInfo tooltip overlay on pointer enter and destroys it on pointer exit. HACK_UIMouseoverInfo Temporary workaround MonoBehaviour for displaying mouseover information text in the flight UI. IVAPortraits Represents the IVA crew portrait panel in the flight HUD, rendering and displaying portrait viewports for each seated Kerbal with EVA interaction and scrolling support. InteractInstrument Flight HUD instrument that displays available interaction prompts and their input key names for the active interact actions. KerbalCamera MonoBehaviour that temporarily overrides shadow cascade, anti-aliasing, and shadow distance quality settings during camera rendering and restores them immediately after each frame. NavballInstrument Represents the navball orientation indicator as a flight HUD instrument. NonStageableResourcesUI Flight HUD instrument for the non-stageable resources panel, binding the resource list element prefab to the resource data context. PhysicsForceDisplaySystem Represents the flight UI system that renders physics force vectors (drag, lift, and thrust) as color-coded overlays on active vessel parts. PhysicsForceDisplayVector Represents a physics force displayed as a debug arrow in the flight view. ThrottleInstrument Represents the throttle display instrument in the flight HUD. TimeWarpInstrument Represents the time warp level selector instrument in the flight HUD. TrackingStationToggleInstrument Represents a flight HUD instrument that toggles the tracking station, binding to the flight HUD context on initialization. UIDependendsOn<T> A base class for UI elements that hold a single backend dependency of type T and manage callback registration when that dependency is replaced. UIElement A base class for flight-scene UI elements with protected helpers for managing child GameObjects and instantiating prefabs. UIFlightHUDInstrument A base class for HUD instrument elements displayed in the flight UI, providing data binding and vessel or colony context classification. UIFlightHud Represents the root flight HUD panel, managing a collection of UIFlightHUDInstrument instances and controlling visibility in response to game state, vessel, and colony events. AssemblyCSharp/KSPPartAudioRTPCs.html.title: Namespace KSPPartAudioRTPCs | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSPPartAudioRTPCs.html.summary: Namespace KSPPartAudioRTPCs Classes KSPPartAudioRTPCBase A base class for KSP part audio RTPC entries that update real-time parameter control values on audio game objects. PartAngularVelocityRTPC RTPC entry that drives the k_angular_velocity audio parameter using the angular velocity magnitude of the owning part's rigidbody. PartAtmDensityRTPC Represents the atmospheric density RTPC for part audio, setting the audio parameter from the part's current atmospheric density. PartDragCoefficientRTPC Represents a part audio RTPC handler that drives the drag-coefficient runtime parameter using the part model's drag coefficient. PartDynamicPressureRTPC RTPC entry that updates the dynamic pressure real-time parameter control value on a part's audio game object. PartGForceRTPC Part audio RTPC entry that drives the g-force real-time parameter control value from the vessel's current g-force. PartJointTorqueRTPC Represents a KSPPartAudioRTPCBase implementation that drives the part stress audio parameter using the maximum joint torque of the owning part. PartMachNumberRTPC Part audio RTPC that reads the current vessel Mach number and applies it to the part audio system. PartMassRTPC Represents a part audio RTPC entry that drives the part mass real-time parameter control value from the part's physics mass. PartSpeedRTPC Represents a KSPPartAudioRTPCBase implementation that updates the part speed RTPC with the vessel's surface speed magnitude. PartStaticPressureRTPC RTPC entry that updates the static pressure real-time parameter control value on a part audio game object using the part's static pressure in kPa. PartTemperatureRTPC RTPC entry that drives the part temperature real-time parameter control from the vessel's external temperature. PartUnderWaterRTPC Represents a KSP part audio RTPC entry that controls the k_part_under_water parameter, setting it to 1 when the part model is submerged and 0 otherwise. PartVelocityMagnitudeRTPC Represents a part audio RTPC entry that updates the velocity magnitude parameter using the part's speed relative to the SOI body frame. TemperatureRatioRTPC RTPC entry that drives the part temperature ratio audio parameter from the heat indicator tracker's temperature ratio value. VesselAltitudeRTPC Represents a KSP part audio RTPC entry that drives the vessel altitude real-time parameter control value on part audio game objects. VesselAtmDensityRTPC Represents a KSPPartAudioRTPCBase that updates the vessel atmospheric density RTPC parameter on part audio game objects. VesselHeightFromGroundRTPC Represents a part audio RTPC entry that drives the vessel height-from-ground parameter using the active vessel's altitude above terrain. VesselStaticPressureRTPC KSP part audio RTPC entry that drives the vessel static pressure parameter with the vessel's current static pressure in kPa.

With this wrapper, a nil result on a string index is retried with isDirectIndexing = false, which routes through the type's this[string] indexer. AssemblyCSharp/PatchManager.LuaPatching..summary: Namespace PatchManager.LuaPatching Classes JsonUserData Lua-facing wrapper exposing a Newtonsoft Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JToken as a table-like UserData. LuaAsset A new asset queued for creation by a Lua patch script. LuaPatchingModule IModule that performs the late assembly scan for the Lua patching universe, registering Lua-exposed types, PatchManager submodules, and converters with MoonSharp once all mod assemblies are loaded. PatchDefinition A registered patch operation: which converter, which addressables target, what callback to run, and at which stage. Universe The central orchestrator for Lua-based patching: loads patch scripts, registers patches and new assets, sorts stages topologically, and runs the resulting pipeline against each patched asset. Universe.LabelPatchBuckets The patches for a single label in a single pass, grouped by how they match an asset name. Structs LuaIndex A position index that bridges the C# 0-based and Lua 1-based array conventions so one method body can serve both languages. C# callers pass a plain int, used as-is (0-based). Lua numbers are turned into a LuaIndex by the global MoonSharp converter, which subtracts 1, so part[1] in Lua and part[0] in C# address the same element. This is the parameter type for every position-taking member (the integer indexer, RemoveAt, Insert). Universe.WildcardEntry A wildcard patch paired with the compiled name pattern it matches against. Interfaces IConverter Bidirectional converter between a JSON token and the Lua-facing MoonSharp.Interpreter.DynValue exposed to patch scripts. AssemblyCSharp/Redux.CelestialBody.Redux.title: Class ReduxSurfaceSpawner | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/Redux.CelestialBody.Redux.summary: Class ReduxSurfaceSpawner Spawns an addressable prefab at a fixed lat/lon/altitude on the parent celestial body, gated by proximity to the active vessel. Inheritance object ReduxSurfaceSpawner Namespace: Redux.CelestialBody Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public class ReduxSurfaceSpawner : MonoBehaviour Remarks The spawn is backed by a standalone ECS entity parented to the body's celestialFrame entity in UniverseSimWorld. Systems.SurfaceAnchorTransformSystem computes the body-local TRS each frame from authored lat/lon/altitude in double precision, and Systems.SurfaceAnchorUnityWriteSystem walks the reference-frame hierarchy down to physics space and writes the resulting world pose onto the spawned instance's Transform. All math happens in Vector3d / QuaternionD - only the final cast to Vector3 loses precision, and that cast happens near the floating origin where float precision is centimeter-scale. The addressable handle is released as soon as the prefab is instantiated. The instance is a runtime copy that survives the release. Subsequent spawn cycles re-load the addressable - the trade-off is more I/O on respawn for less memory held while no instance is active. A value of 0 sits on the surface, positive values float above it, and negative values sink below. AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Ecs.CompilerService.summary: Namespace Redux.Ecs.CompilerServices Classes BlobFloatCurveBuilder Builds a BlobFloatCurve from a managed FloatCurve. ChangesetOps Core operation definitions for types which can be used as a changeset in the code generated for types implementing IPartModuleData. ModuleConfigBlobRegistry Per-Unity.Entities.World content-addressed cache of part-module config blobs. Module config is immutable and identical across instances of a part type, so every instance shares one blob keyed by its content hash. Backed by Unity.Entities.BlobAssetStore, which owns the blobs and disposes them all when the world tears down (via ModuleConfigCleanupSystem). ModuleNotifyFixedGroup Holds the per-type module notify systems; runs after the scan group. ModuleNotifyUpdateGroup Per-frame counterpart of ModuleNotifyFixedGroup under SimUpdateGroup. ModuleScanFixedGroup Holds the per-type module change scan systems at the end of the sim fixed-update tick. ModuleScanUpdateGroup Per-frame counterpart of ModuleScanFixedGroup under SimUpdateGroup. Structs BlobFloatCurve A FloatCurve baked into a blob-resident lookup table so it can be evaluated from Burst. Mirrors FloatCurveStruct: the curve is pre-sampled into a fixed-size table over [0, MaxTime]. ModuleConfigCleanupSystem Disposes this world's ModuleConfigBlobRegistry when the world tears down. The system does no per-frame work; it exists only so its OnDestroy(ref SystemState) runs. ModuleConfigHasher Accumulates a content hash over a module config's source values so identical configs resolve to the same shared blob in ModuleConfigBlobRegistry. Codegen feeds every blob-bound field through the matching Add overload. ModuleNotifyFixedSystem<TData, TChangeset, TBinding> Notify pass at the end of the sim fixed-update tick, after the scan pass. ModuleNotifyUpdateSystem<TData, TChangeset, TBinding> Per-frame notify pass under SimUpdateGroup. ModulePropertyState<T> A serializable type that has the same shape as ModuleProperty<T>. ModuleScanFixedSystem<TData, TChangeset> Scan pass at the end of the sim fixed-update tick. ModuleScanUpdateSystem<TData, TChangeset> Per-frame scan pass under SimUpdateGroup. Interfaces IModuleStateSerializable Interface indicating that a type has a custom "state type" that it uses for serialization. IPartModuleNotifier<TChangeset> An interface implemented by generated managed module bindings. You should never need to use this directly.

AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Ecs.Components.Curr.summary: Class CurrentPatchedConicsOrbit Managed ECS component representing the current patched-conics orbit patch for an entity. Unmanaged orbital data is read from and written to the entity's PatchedConicsOrbitData component; managed-side state (velocity, patch graph) is stored directly on this class. The reference body is identified by ReferenceBodyEntity and resolved to a CelestialBodyComponent on demand via SimObjectManagedData.
