AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Ecs.Components.html.title: Namespace Redux.Ecs.Components | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Ecs.Components.html.summary: Namespace Redux.Ecs.Components Classes CurrentPatchedConicsOrbit Managed ECS component representing the current patched-conics orbit patch for an entity. Unmanaged orbital data is read from and written to the entity's PatchedConicsOrbitData component; managed-side state (velocity, patch graph) is stored directly on this class. The reference body is identified by ReferenceBodyEntity and resolved to a CelestialBodyComponent on demand via SimObjectManagedData. ModuleManagedData Managed back-reference from a module entity to its ModuleData entries, letting ModuleEntities unbind the managed side before the entity is destroyed. OabAssemblyManagedData Managed back-reference from an editor assembly entity to its ObjectAssembly. OabPartManagedData Managed back-reference from an editor part entity to its ObjectAssemblyPart. PartMembership Stamps and strips the part-owner membership component set (PartVessel, PartOwnerRef, and the PartParent/PartChild attachment-tree placeholders) on a part entity, shared by flight (PartOwnerComponent) and the editor (ObjectAssembly). ResourceRequestEntity Creates and tears down resource-flow request entities and toggles their active flag. A request entity is the sole identity of a request: it carries RequestVessel (shared, the solve filter), RequestPart, a ResourceFlowRequest header, its own ResourceFlowInstructionData buffer, a ResourceFlowResponse, and a ResourceFlowFailedResource buffer. ResourceRequestIndex Reserved values for Index. The index is a caller-defined discriminator, never an identity or dedup key. SimObjectManagedData SurfaceAnchorUnityLink Managed back-reference from a surface-anchor entity to the Unity Transform the writer system pushes the world pose into. Structs AncestorList A list of ancestor entities (entity.parent.parent.parent... etc) starting with, and including the current entity. This is backward from the way this is normally handled, but allowed constructing the list from leaf to root without reversing. AngularVelocityD Unmanaged equivalent of AngularVelocity: a relative angular velocity (itself a frame-bound VectorD) plus the entity whose motion frame it is relative to. BoundViewObject CelestialBodyChild One orbiting child of a celestial body. Each body holds a buffer of its children; the CelestialBodyHierarchyRoot singleton holds the stars. CelestialBodyHasRotationUpdate Marks that a body's rotation changed this tick. The celestial-body ordered update owns the flag: it clears it at the start of each update and re-enables it only when it recomputes the rotation. The legacy fixed update reads it to raise CelestialBodyComponent.RotationUpdated and CelestialBodyComponent.AngularVelocityUpdated. CelestialBodyHierarchyRoot Singleton root of the celestial-body tree; its CelestialBodyChild buffer holds the stars. CelestialBodySimData Unmanaged source of truth for the celestial-body fields driven by CelestialBodyOrderedUpdateSystem, exposed as accessor properties on CelestialBodyComponent. ContainerOwner Links a resource-container entity to the part entity that owns it. CoolerRequiredResource One resource a cooler consumes while operating (rate and acceptance threshold), stamped onto the cooler module entity from the managed required-resource settings with names resolved to runtime ids. CoolingEnergyToApply MassModifierData Per-module mass contribution, written on a module entity by its part-module system and scattered into the owning part's PartMassModifier by MassAggregateSystem. ModulePart The part entity that a part-module entity belongs to. A module instance lives on its own entity and resolves its owning part's data through this back-reference. ModuleRequestEntity The resource-flow request entity owned by a part-module entity. Backs RequestEntity; added when the module first allocates a request. OrbitStabilityData Tracks whether a vessel's patched-conics orbit is currently stable, so OrbitStabilitySystem can emit an event on the unstable-to-stable edge. OrbiterData Authoritative unmanaged state for OrbiterComponent. OrbiterFrame The orbiter's own celestial frame entity; its Transformd holds the live (physics-driven) position the orbit-driver job resolves the owning body from when the orbiter is off-rails. OrbiterMainBody The body whose SOI owns this orbiter, resolved each tick by the orbit-driver job. Unity.Entities.Entity.Null when unresolved this tick: a celestial body, no reference body, or the job has not run yet. OverheatEvent Emitted by the thermal finalize job when a part's temperature exceeds its maximum, so a later managed system can destroy it without the Burst pipeline taking a sync point. PartChild One attachment-tree child of a part within its part owner, as an entity reference. The buffer on a part entity holds all of its children. Rebuilt by UpdatePartRelationships(). PartComponentData Unmanaged source of truth for the blittable state of a part, exposed as accessor properties on PartComponent. PartMassModifier A per-part component that is used by the mass update to sum up all mass modifiers on the part. PartModuleRef One part-module entity owned by a part, as an entity reference. The buffer on a part entity holds every module instance mounted on that part. Maintained by ModuleEntities as modules are bound and removed. PartOwnerData Unmanaged source of truth for the plain (blittable) state of a part owner, exposed as accessor properties on PartOwnerComponent. PartOwnerRef The part owner entity a part belongs to (Unity.Entities.Entity.Null when unowned). Maintained alongside the part's PartVessel shared component as parts are added to and removed from owners. PartParent The attachment-tree parent of a part within its part owner, as an entity reference (Unity.Entities.Entity.Null for the root or a part with no parent). Rebuilt by UpdatePartRelationships(). PartVessel The part-owner (vessel) entity that a part belongs to, as a shared component so that all parts of a single vessel are grouped into the same chunks. This lets a query filter a vessel's parts with SetSharedComponentFilter and reduce a per-part component across the whole vessel without walking managed state. Stamped and stripped alongside the PartOwnerComponent membership buffer. PatchedConicsOrbitData Unmanaged Keplerian state for a patched-conics orbit: the orbital elements plus the values derived from them during propagation. PatchedConicsOrbit holds one of these and forwards its public API to it; the Keplerian math is (being) moved onto this struct as instance methods so it can later run in a Burst job. PhysicsSpaceFrame Singleton exposing the inertial reference frame entity (the PhysX/floating-origin frame) to Burst jobs, so they can perform the velocity/angular conversions otherwise only available on the managed PhysicsSpace provider. PhysicsStatsDirty Enableable tag on part-owner and part entities: enabled means the owner's physics stats need recomputing. Set on the owner by PartOwnerComponent (per-frame in OnLateUpdate, on structural changes, and by the forced recalculation path), broadcast onto the owner's parts by BroadcastDirtyFlagSystem, and cleared once the physics reduce has recomputed the owner. The part-level and owner-level reduce jobs filter on it, so clean owners are skipped entirely. PositionD Unmanaged equivalent of Position: a position value plus the transform-frame entity it is expressed in. RequestPart The part entity a resource-flow request flows against. Doubles as the plan-lookup flow target. RequestVessel The part-owner (vessel) entity that a resource-flow request belongs to, as a shared component so all of a vessel's request entities are grouped into the same chunks. The solve filters a vessel's requests with SetSharedComponentFilter. Derived from the request's RequestPart's PartVessel and reconciled when the part changes owner (docking, re-parent). ResourceDefinitionRow An unmanaged mirror of ResourceDefinitionData. ResourceDefinitionsCacheTag Tag identifying the singleton entity that carries the baked resource definition buffers (ResourceDefinitionRow and ResourceIngredientRow). ResourceFlowFailedResource One resource a request failed to process this tick. Populated only on rejection; cleared before each solve. ResourceFlowInstructionData One compiled flow instruction on a request entity. The buffer holds exactly this request's instructions — one buffer is one request, so there are no slice fields. The flow target is not stored here; it is the request's RequestPart. ResourceFlowRequest Header for a resource-flow request entity: a control flag plus a non-identity discriminator. The request's instructions live in its own ResourceFlowInstructionData buffer and the entity is the identity, so there is no handle and no buffer slice. ResourceFlowResponse Output of the solve for a request entity. Rejected resources are recorded in the ResourceFlowFailedResource buffer. ResourceIngredientRow One recipe ingredient: the resource moved per unit of the recipe resource. Referenced by ResourceDefinitionRow ingredient slices. ResourceStoredEntry One per-resource storage slot of a ResourceContainer. RigidbodyData Unmanaged source of truth for the blittable state of a rigidbody, exposed as accessor properties on RigidbodyComponent. RotationD Unmanaged equivalent of Rotation: a local rotation value plus the transform-frame entity it is expressed in. SimObjectData Unmanaged type flags for a SimulationObjectModel, packed into a single bitset and exposed as boolean accessors. SurfaceAnchorData Per-anchor data for a surface-anchored entity managed by SurfaceAnchorTransformSystem. TelemetryData Unmanaged source of truth for the plain flight-telemetry state of a simulation object, exposed as accessor properties on TelemetryComponent. ThermalBodyContext Per-owner body chain (main body up through its reference bodies); each entry is a body and its surface-flux base. ThermalOwnerData Per-vessel thermal aggregates on the part owner entity: the sum of per-part cooling demand, the vessel's total cooling budget from its operational coolers, and the main body's atmospheric temperature at the vessel's altitude. Transformd Struct representing ECS transform data. UniverseRotationState Singleton holding the universe-wide inverse-rotation frame state. VectorD Unmanaged equivalent of Vector: a vector value plus the transform-frame entity it is expressed in. VelocityD Unmanaged equivalent of Velocity: a relative velocity (itself a frame-bound VectorD) plus the entity whose motion frame it is relative to. VesselData Unmanaged source of truth for a vessel's physics mode and per-tick derived dynamics, aero, and attitude scalars, exposed as accessor properties on VesselComponent. VesselRoot Indicates which part is the root part of the vessel.

AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Ecs.ModuleEntities..summary: Class ModuleEntities Creates and tears down the per-instance entity that backs a single part module. Every module gets its own entity carrying its generated state component(s), config blob, the managed module object, and a ModulePart back-reference to the part. The part entity records its modules in a PartModuleRef buffer. Shared by the flight (PartComponent) and editor (ObjectAssemblyPart) binding paths. Inheritance object ModuleEntities Namespace: Redux.Ecs Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public static class ModuleEntities Methods Create(EntityManager, Entity, object, ModuleDataList, IReadOnlyDictionary<Type, JObject>) Creates the module entity for module, links it to partEntity, mirrors the part's current vessel membership onto it, binds each of the module's ModuleData, and appends it to the part's PartModuleRef buffer. Serialized state carried in pendingStateJson (keyed by data type) is applied to each data object immediately after its bind, so the values land directly in ECS. Returns the new module entity. AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Ecs.Systems.Surface.summary: Class SurfaceAnchorUnityWriteSystem Pushes each surface-anchor entity's world pose onto its managed Unity Transform. Inheritance object ComponentSystemBase SystemBase SurfaceAnchorUnityWriteSystem Namespace: Redux.Ecs.Systems Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax [UpdateInGroup(typeof(LateSimulationSystemGroup))] [UpdateAfter(typeof(SurfaceAnchorTransformSystem))] public class SurfaceAnchorUnityWriteSystem : SystemBase Remarks Runs after SurfaceAnchorTransformSystem in Unity.Entities.LateSimulationSystemGroup. Walks each anchor's frame hierarchy down into the active physics-space reference frame using the static helpers on Transformd, so all frame-conversion math stays in doubles. The only float cast happens on the final assignment to Transform, which sits near the floating origin where float precision is centimeter-scale. Suppresses transform writes whose delta from the previously-applied pose is below ~5 mm in position and ~0.01 degrees in rotation. This both avoids the Unity transform-dirty cost when nothing meaningful changed and prevents sub-millimeter precision noise from twitching the rendered pose. EntityModuleProperty<TComponent, TValue> A ModuleProperty<T> that forwards writes to a field of the unmanaged ECS component TComponent. ModuleChangesetAttribute This is used by codegen to mark the field used to implement field change tracking. ModuleEntities Creates and tears down the per-instance entity that backs a single part module. Every module gets its own entity carrying its generated state component(s), config blob, the managed module object, and a ModulePart back-reference to the part. The part entity records its modules in a PartModuleRef buffer. Shared by the flight (PartComponent) and editor (ObjectAssemblyPart) binding paths. ModulePropertyAttribute Marks a field on a [PartModuleDefinition] class or component as a property visible in the PAW. ModuleStateAttribute Marks a field on a part module component as a plain (untracked) value. PartModuleDefinitionAttribute Marks the definition class for a part module. ResourceDefinitionsCache Maintains an unmanaged mirror of the resource definition database for use by ECS systems. AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Lua.WaitLibrary.htm.title: Class WaitLibrary | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Lua.WaitLibrary.htm.summary:
Class WaitLibrary Backs the Lua Wait global with the small set of C# leaf checks its yield loops poll each frame. Inheritance object WaitLibrary Namespace: Redux.Lua Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax [MoonSharpUserData] public sealed class WaitLibrary Remarks The Wait surface itself is defined in Lua (see Prelude) because MoonSharp cannot yield a host coroutine from inside a CLR call - the loops must run on the Lua side, calling these leaves. Blocking forms (for example Wait.Seconds(2)) yield the calling coroutine until satisfied, so they only work inside a coroutine context (a console body, or a Game.StartCoroutine body). The callback forms (for example Wait.Seconds(2, fn)) are sugar that wraps the blocking form in Game.StartCoroutine, so they also work from a synchronous mod body. "Stop" is the runner ceasing to resume the coroutine, so the loops need no explicit cancel check. Stateless, one shared instance per env. Constructors WaitLibrary() Declaration public WaitLibrary() Fields LeafGlobal The name of the temporary global the prelude reads this leaf object from, then clears. Declaration public const string LeafGlobal = "__ReduxWaitLeaf" Field Value Type Description string Prelude The Lua source that defines the Wait table. Run once per environment with the leaf object already set as the LeafGlobal global. Declaration public const string Prelude = "
local leaf = __ReduxWaitLeaf
__ReduxWaitLeaf = nil

Wait = {}

function Wait.Seconds(seconds, callback)
 if callback ~= nil then
 return Game.StartCoroutine(function()
 Wait.Seconds(seconds)
 callback()
 end)
 end
 local start = leaf.Now()
 while (leaf.Now() - start) < seconds do
 coroutine.yield()
 end
end

function Wait.Until(predicate, timeoutSeconds, callback)
 if callback ~= nil then
 return Game.StartCoroutine(function()
 local satisfied = Wait.Until(predicate, timeoutSeconds)
 callback(satisfied)
 end)
 end
 local start = leaf.Now()
 while true do
 if predicate() then return true end
 if timeoutSeconds ~= nil and timeoutSeconds > 0 and (leaf.Now() - start) >= timeoutSeconds then
 return false
 end
 coroutine.yield()
 end
end

function Wait.InputDown(key, callback)
 if callback ~= nil then
 return Game.StartCoroutine(function()
 Wait.InputDown(key)
 callback()
 end)
 end
 while not leaf.KeyDown(key) do
 coroutine.yield()
 end
end

function Wait.Input(key, callback)
 return Wait.InputDown(key, callback)
end

function Wait.InputUp(key, callback)
 if callback ~= nil then
 return Game.StartCoroutine(function()
 Wait.InputUp(key)
 callback()
 end)
 end
 while not leaf.KeyUp(key) do
 coroutine.yield()
 end
end

function Wait.InputHeld(key, holdSeconds, callback)
 if callback ~= nil then
 return Game.StartCoroutine(function()
 Wait.InputHeld(key, holdSeconds)
 callback()
 end)
 end
 local held = 0.0
 local last = leaf.Now()
 while true do
 local now = leaf.Now()
 if leaf.KeyHeld(key) then
 held = held + (now - last)
 if held >= (holdSeconds or 0.0) then
 return
 end
 else
 held = 0.0
 end
 last = now
 coroutine.yield()
 end
end

function Wait.Event(eventName, timeoutSeconds, callback)
 Log.Warning("Wait.Event('" .. tostring(eventName) .. "') is not implemented yet.")
 if timeoutSeconds ~= nil and timeoutSeconds > 0 then
 return Wait.Seconds(timeoutSeconds, callback)
 end
 return false
end

SpaceWarp/SpaceWarp2.API.Lifecycle.ModRe.title: Class ModRequire | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
SpaceWarp/SpaceWarp2.API.Lifecycle.ModRe.summary: Class ModRequire A require implementation that resolves and runs modules against the calling mod's forked environment instead of the shared root globals. Inheritance object ModRequire Namespace: SpaceWarp2.API.Lifecycle Assembly: SpaceWarp2.dll Syntax public static class ModRequire Remarks MoonSharp's stock require resolves the module name and runs the module against the root global table, so the ModScriptLoader would never see the per-mod ModId/Location and a required module would lose access to that mod's globals. Installing this on each forked environment forwards the environment to MoonSharp.Interpreter.Script.RequireModule(string, MoonSharp.Interpreter.Table) as its global context, which both feeds the loader the right mod id and runs the module with that environment as its _ENV (so nested requires re-enter against the same env). Results are cached per environment via a weak-keyed table, so a module shared by two mods runs once per mod and the cache drops when the env is collected. Methods InstallOn(Table) Installs the mod-aware require as a global on the given forked environment's globals table. Declaration public static void InstallOn(Table envGlobals) Parameters Type Name Description Table envGlobals The forked environment's globals table.

UitkForKsp2/UitkForKsp2.API.Order.OrderM.summary: Class OrderManager Provides functionality to manage and maintain the sorting order of per-window PanelSettings instances (and Canvases), allowing them to be registered, brought to the front, and unregistered. Each window owns its PanelSettings, and that asset's sortingOrder is what governs z-order both among UITK panels and relative to uGUI canvases. The UnityEngine.UIElements.PanelRenderer overloads operate on the renderer's PanelSettings. UitkForKsp2/UitkForKsp2.MVVM.Bindings.Co.summary: Class CommandBinding Convenience binding for Button.clicked -> ICommand. Wires the button's clicked event and enable state to a parameterless command on the data source. Composite controls can use target-name to bind a named descendant button. UitkForKsp2/UitkForKsp2.MVVM.Bindings.Ev.title: Class EventBinding | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
UitkForKsp2/UitkForKsp2.MVVM.Bindings.Ev.summary: Class EventBinding Binds any UI Toolkit event on any VisualElement to an ICommand or ICommand<TEvent> on the data source. Works with every EventBase subclass - clicks, pointer, keyboard, focus, change, drag, navigation, and more. UXML usage: <!-- Parameterless: event fires command, data discarded --> <EventBinding property="name" data-source-path="HoverCommand" event-type="PointerEnterEvent" /> <!-- Typed: ViewModel receives full event object --> <EventBinding property="value" data-source-path="KeyDownCommand" event-type="KeyDownEvent" /> <!-- ChangeEvent special case: extracts newValue automatically --> <EventBinding property="value" data-source-path="VolumeCommand" event-type="ChangeEvent<System.Single>" /> The "property" attribute is required by the infrastructure but unused - set it to any valid property (e.g. "name"). Reflection runs only once per command instance - subsequent updates only sync enabled state.
